summary: This Secret History lecture is already public Taboo evidence for sin as a wall-breaking technology, and it adds high-pressure but caveated Frankist-modernity routing across Secret Society, Stories, Eschatology, Power, Dead World/Cave, Poetry, and Prediction without justifying a standalone Frankism or Faith of Evil page.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The episode read already links the central phrases "sin becomes a technology," "faith is stronger than the laws of men," "breaking rabbinic law can prove faith," "Sin is not chaos; it is fuel," and "a taboo wall" to the Taboo anchor.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Taboo owns the active mechanism when forbidden breach, sin, and social-law violation are reclassified as proof of faith, a knowledge method, and a way to turn guilt into discipline.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: preserve this source as the classroom spine for sin-as-taboo-technology. Zevi makes conversion a messianic descent; Frank radicalizes inherited law into the false world's control surface; the final student answer states that sin is taboo, an invisible wall, and should be used for deeper knowledge rather than sin for its own sake.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Taboo owns the forbidden boundary. Secret Society owns secrecy, covenant, and organization after the breach; Eschatology owns messianic age and material paradise scripts; Stories owns parables and imagination as transmission; Power owns money and material conversion.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only in a future replacement/compression pass, with attribution and caveat: the source describes covenantal secrecy, disguise, hierarchy, love, money, discipline, guilt, and negative emotion as the ingredients of a powerful hidden organization.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Do not use the source as a verified membership ledger. Secret Society owns the reusable coordination model only when the claim is secrecy-bound trust, covenant, transgression, and exit-binding; Taboo owns the sin wall itself.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold for the next Stories replacement/compression or story-virus review: Frank teaches by stories because stories plant themselves in the mind and grow over time; later, imagination becomes the medium in which readers, viewers, and students enter someone else's world.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Stories owns narrative transmission and imagination-world entry. Poetry owns Yeats as poetic portal; Education owns pedagogy only when the school/formation mechanism is primary.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as held pressure for a future child-specific eschatology comparison: the lecture recodes waiting for the messiah into becoming the messianic age, then turns paradise into a material world made by believers rather than a spiritual afterlife awaited passively.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns messianic age, end-of-world acceleration, and material paradise scripts. Prediction owns dated Israel-Palestine/Pax Judaica branch status; Taboo owns transgression as the mechanism that makes the script actionable.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold as secondary evidence for money becoming spiritual access: the source says silver answers everything and that drawing near God is impossible without money, but this should not become an ordinary Power append while the parent is in replacement/compression mode.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns monetary signs becoming lived and sacred access. Taboo owns boundary-breaking; Secret Society owns the organization that uses money, secrecy, and guilt.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold for future comparison: the source says the world is a corpse, reality is hallucination, and social laws are invented walls; this may support Dead World/Cave only when the active mechanism is false material reality rather than taboo breach.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Dead World owns ontology and hallucinated reality; Taboo remains the better home for the source's public anchor because the lecture's operational move is breaking the invisible wall.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use Yeats/Faust only in future Poetry replacement/compression if literary descent through foulness, sin, and bodily lowliness needs comparison with Homer, Dante, Joyce, Shakespeare, and Jesus as poet-prophet portals.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Poetry owns the literary portal and civilizational memory form. Taboo owns the forbidden act; Dead World owns descent/garbage ontology; Human Heart owns love and self-creation only when relation or moral recognition is central.

new_lens_seeds.title: Faith Through Transgression
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A forbidden act can be recoded as the only proof that faith is stronger than inherited law, turning sin, guilt, social hatred, and secrecy into discipline and group power.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism recurs across Zevi, Frank, Faust, taboo, secret-society binding, and end-times acceleration, but the current Taboo page already carries the durable public anchor.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold as a comparison seed. Public extraction would duplicate `taboo-sin-turns-wall-into-technology` unless later sources prove a separate reader surface beyond taboo.

new_lens_seeds.title: Story Seeds Train Imagination
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A story can be planted like a seed in the mind, grow after direct doctrine is forgotten, and train the listener to inhabit a world built by another imagination.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This connects Frank's parables, story-virus pressure, reading as world-entry, poetry as civilization, and education as soul formation.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold under the existing Stories parent and the earlier story-virus seed until a concept-scoped review decides whether story infection, imagination entry, and literary portal are one child or neighboring mechanisms.

new_lens_seeds.title: Frankist Material Salvation
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Salvation is recoded from spiritual obedience into material wisdom, money, pleasure, no-death, and paradise made on earth by people who stop waiting for rescue.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism could help compare Eschatology, Power, Secret Society, AI/transhumanism, and Pax Judaica material-salvation claims, but it is too source-specific and sensitive for a standalone public page now.
new_lens_seeds.reason: Hold for comparison with later Pax Judaica, AI-immortality, transhumanism, and eschatology sources. Do not promote from this lecture alone.
